tagline: Hunt any finding — by plugin, CVE, severity or finding ID.
problem: Finding every instance of one vulnerability — a CVE in the news, a plugin a vendor just flagged — shouldn't mean writing SQL or waiting on a report.
does: Explorer › Vulnerabilities searches every finding in navi.db, one row each, by plugin name or ID, CVE, severity or finding ID, and shows each finding with its asset and VPR. A finding ID opens it in Tenable, the asset opens Asset Dossier, and a fix can be handed to Remote Remediation.

glance.caption: Explorer › Vulnerabilities's results: one row per finding with plugin, severity, VPR and asset — each linking to Tenable, Asset Dossier or an Remote Remediation fix.

capabilities: plugin name, plugin ID, CVE, severity or finding ID.
asset, severity and VPR on every row.
a finding ID opens that finding in Tenable.
the asset opens Asset Dossier; Remediate hands the plugin and host to Remote Remediation, pre-filled, never auto-run.
send the rows to an owner through Notify & Reports.
how: Explorer › Vulnerabilities runs a read-only search over the findings in your local navi.db; results page on the server, 20 rows a page (up to 50).
who: Analysts answering "where do we have this?" and responders scoping a new CVE.
better: Part of the search pack with Explorer › Assets, Explorer › Plugins, Explorer › Routes and Explorer › Paths. Laelaps and Exposure Score rank what Explorer › Vulnerabilities finds; Remote Remediation fixes it.
cta: Name the vulnerability — Explorer › Vulnerabilities finds every instance.
